card.text: A star 27 parsecs away, 3.4 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Beta Eridani"
sources.quote: Beta Eridani, formally named Cursa, is the second-brightest star in the barely equatorial-southern constellation of Eridanus, located in the northeast end of this constellation near the shared border with Orion.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 43 times the Sun's luminosity at 7,997 K, so 3.439 solar radii.

sources.label: McDonald et al. (2017), Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society 471 770-791

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Beta Eridani"
sources.quote: The apparent visual magnitude of this star is 2.796, so it can be viewed with the naked eye in dark skies.
